name: CSSnippets
summary: Collection of copy-paste UI snippets in HTML, React, CSS and Tailwind CSS: buttons, cards, forms, toggles and more.
description: A library of ready-to-use UI code snippets built with HTML, React, CSS and Tailwind CSS, organised by component category across 14 docs pages — buttons, box-shadows, cards, checkboxes, dropdowns, forms, radio, toggles, input fields, loaders, masonry and text styles. The site is JavaScript-rendered, so only its title, meta description and item names were readable.
contains: snippets in HTML, React, CSS and Tailwind CSS
categories: buttons, box-shadows, cards, checkboxes, dropdowns, forms, toggles, input fields, loaders
